command: set -euo pipefail; test "$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {c++} END{print c+0}')" = '1'; echo MODEL=$(adb shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r'); echo BTSNOOP_MODE=$(adb shell settings get global bluetooth_btsnooplogmode 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r'); echo HCI_SECURE=$(adb shell settings get secure bluetooth_hci_log 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r'); echo HCI_GLOBAL=$(adb shell settings get global bluetooth_hci_log 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')
